tableLines.line: 👂 Overheard — A woman, maybe 30s, with ink-stained fingers (to A person, maybe 50s): "the woman in her 50s's story has a fresh coat of paint." A woman, maybe 30s, with ink-stained fingers taps the table. "Scrape it off and you get from Lima, Peru. Just don't scrape it in front of them."
💔 A faction of Emberhold has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Oscar.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Sam speaks at Ashford's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
A runner from The Red Table, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the northeast ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)
📓 Codex: you've heard of Harvest Table. Someone, somewhere, can do this. Now you know its name.
◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Lena — Social 1. Three offers; they took Harvest Table. Earned, chosen. (harvest_table: villager level-up)
📓 Codex: Lena chose Harvest Table (harvest_table) at Social 1.
🧳 A traveler passed through yesterday, talking about a village to the northeast called The Red Table. The region is bigger than your fire.
🧳 Word comes late, through traders: The Red Table has bound itself to Emberhold. The region's map is being redrawn — not by Haven.
🥣 Peter of The Red Table walks into your firelight alone, thinner than you remember. "Our jars are empty," they say. No preamble. "I'm asking for food."
Peter waits two days at your fire, getting thinner. Nobody answers. They walk back to The Red Table with nothing. They'll remember the silence.
◈ THE TABLE IS SET. A ring of pale light waits — take your seat from Haven when you are ready. Nothing is final until you sit.

🌙 Raid — The Red Table came in the night from the northeast. They carried off ~600 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)
🧳 Word from The Red Table: Hank is dead, and Marcus and Peter both claim the fire. The Red Table is choosing — or fighting.

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and

The little star inside Aria goes quiet — and wakes up inside Tashi. Aria never got hungry while the village did, so the pellet moved to hungrier hands: Tashi will never be hungry again while it hums, and Aria is hungry again, for the first time in a long while. The table can hear a feast again.
